subject: Pricing appeal and requested credit for Dedicated commit - Sierra Therapeutics
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@sierra-thera.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sierra-thera.com
Date: 2026-08-30T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated commit inquiry + competitive pricing

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Sierra Therapeutics is excited about Redwood's latency profiles and the KV caching behavior. We ran the numbers internally and have a parallel offer from a competitor that is materially more aggressive on the first year economics.

High level: we need a Dedicated GPU pool sized for sustained medium throughput (roughly 8 A100-equivalents sustained, peaks to 12 for batch inference). Target start date Oct 1. The competing vendor is proposing a 25% off list for year one plus 3 months of free credits (applied as preloaded credits usable for first 90 days).

Before we proceed further with procurement, can Redwood match or otherwise bridge this gap? Specific asks from procurement: 1) list price for 12/24 mo reserved commit (8 GPU baseline) 2) any one-time or usage credits you can provide 3) written throughput/latency baseline we can include in the SOW.

I've attached the competitor quote for reference. Procurement is looped here. If it helps, we are prioritizing reliability and an SLA that covers sustained throughput rather than occasional bursts.

Appreciate a quick read — we are hoping to get to legal/procurement within the week.

Best,
Sara
Sara Jenkins
Head of ML Infrastructure
Sierra Therapeutics
Attachments: Sierra_Comp_Quote_Aug2026.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@sierra-thera.com>
Cc: procurement@sierra-thera.com
Date: 2026-08-30T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated commit inquiry + competitive pricing

Sara — thanks for the context and for sharing the quote. Really appreciate the clarity on throughput and timing.

Quick summary of what Redwood can offer today:
- Proposal: 12-month reserved commit for an 8-GPU baseline (A100-equivalent), with automated burst capacity up to 12 GPUs for scheduled batch windows.
- Pricing: list price $XX,XXX / month for baseline (I include a detailed term sheet as an attachment).
- Credits: we can offer a strategic account introductory credit equal to 15% of the first 3 months' invoice (applied as account credit).
- SLA: we provide throughput-focused SLOs in the Dedicated terms: guaranteed baseline throughput equivalent to X requests/sec at p95 <= Y ms for the specified model family; fallback policy to a compatible model variant if capacity constrained.

I want to be transparent: we don't typically do a straight match to 25% off list for first year, but we are open to a competitive response for strategic accounts. If you can give me an ask (e.g., do you need full 25% year-one or is a combination of discount + credits acceptable?), I can route an exception to my manager and finance for an approval.

Attaching: RT_dedicated_term_sheet_v2.pdf (proposed pricing, SLA bullets, and technical appendix).

Quick question for procurement: is there a preferred contracting cadence (12 vs 24) and any required data residency language?

Thanks — I can escalate for an exception today if you confirm the exact target.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: RT_dedicated_term_sheet_v2.pdf
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@sierra-thera.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sierra-thera.com
Date: 2026-08-30T20:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated commit inquiry + competitive pricing

Priyom — thanks for the prompt reply and the term sheet.

Procurement's position: we need parity with the incumbent's commercials for year one to present to the CFO. Specifically: 20–25% off list for year one (we can consider tiered step-ups in year two), plus 3 months of preloaded credits (the credits make the go/no-go for our early-stage usage while we ramp).

Data residency: US-only region is sufficient for now, but the SOW needs a clause that data is persisted in our VPC region and audit logs are exportable monthly.

We appreciate that Redwood values enterprise pricing discipline — happy to find a close compromise. If an executive-level price match / credit exception is needed, please escalate.

Best,
Sara
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T21:05:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Sierra Therapeutics price match / credit exception (summary + ask)

Team — looping you in. Sierra is a strategic prospect (high-growth, strong product-market fit in a regulated vertical). They have an incumbent quote at 25% off list + 3 months credits. Below a short summary and my recommended approach.

Deal snapshot:
- Account: Sierra Therapeutics
- Proposed commit: 8 A100-equivalent baseline, burst to 12 for batch windows
- Requested start: Oct 1
- Comp incumbent commercial: 25% off list in year one + 3 months preloaded credits
- Our initial offer: 15% intro credit (applied to first 3 months) + standard Dedicated pricing (see attached).

Business rationale for concession:
- High strategic value: referenceable in healthcare, potential for Dedicated upsell and platform-wide adoption across R&D and commercial teams.
- Short procurement timeline — they want a signed PO early September.

Recommended concession (flexible):
- Price: 18% off list for year one (conditional on a 24-month commit);
- Credits: 1 month preloaded credits + an additional one-time credit of $25,000 applied to the account at start;
- SLA: include the requested data residency and monthly audit log export;
- Contract term: prefer 24 months to secure renewals and amortize onboarding.

Ask: authorization to go to 18% + $25k one-time credit (in addition to 1 month introductory credit) in exchange for a signed 24-month committed contract. Estimated ARR / TCV if accepted: ~$1.1M TCV (conservative).

I've attached the updated term sheet (RT_dedicated_term_sheet_v2.pdf) and the competitor quote they provided. If approved, we will send a revised term + DocuSign link to procurement today.

Thanks — Priyom
Attachments: RT_dedicated_term_sheet_v2.pdf; Sierra_Comp_Quote_Aug2026.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T23:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Sierra Therapeutics price match / credit exception (summary + ask)

Priyom — thanks for the clear summary. I support a competitive, but measured, concession for Sierra given the strategic upside. My conditional approval:

- Allow 18% off list for year one if customer signs a 24-month committed term.
- Approve 1 month preloaded credits.
- Approve a one-time credit of up to $25,000, contingent on VP/Exec signoff for anything beyond that.

Karthik — please prepare an exception memo + Finance pricing impact and draft the DocuSign packet (term sheet + SOW) so we can get this over to procurement ASAP. Marissa — can you confirm final signoff for the $25k credit and contractual approval?

If Marissa confirms, Priyom — send the updated term and the DocuSign link to Sierra and request a PO by next week.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Sierra Therapeutics price match / credit exception (summary + ask)

Approved.

My read: giving a modest uplift on the credit (we're already approving 1 month + $25k) in exchange for a 24-month commit and a public healthcare reference is in-line with our GTM playbook. Approve the 18% off list for year one and the $25k one-time credit. Finance: greenlight the exception and update the ARR/TCO model.

Priyom — proceed to send the updated term sheet and DocuSign link to Sierra. Make sure the SOW includes the data residency and audit log export phrasing they requested. Please also add a clause for a mutual PR/reference.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
